testcase.name: Scenario: Switch from Pan to Zoom using the contextual menu: tmp/obk-pan-48987af/features/application/viewport-pan/viewport-pan.feature:37:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch from Pan to Zoom using the contextual menu ✔ Given a part containing a visible solid is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And Pan is active from the viewport navigation bar ✔ When the user right-clicks an empty area of the viewport ✔ And the user chooses Zoom from the contextual menu ✔ Then the contextual menu closes ✔ And the status area prompts for zooming and indicates cancellation is available ✔ And the same part and solid remain visible ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the status area returns to Ready
